text: Caught up with Aaliyah after work. Her driving test is Friday at 3pm and she's properly nervous, failed the last one on a roundabout. Her brother Hamza is giving her a lesson the day before. Text her good luck that morning.
Matilda's grade 6 piano recital is on the 12th at half 9. Elena reckons she's been practising four hours a day. I'm driving them both there.

Long call with Samir. He got into the uni football first team, first match is Saturday morning away at Leeds. His dad is going up to watch. He also mentioned his knee has been playing up since the summer. Should ask how the match went the next day.
Siobhan's results day is Thursday. She thinks chemistry went badly and hasn't slept much. Her mum's taking the day off to be with her. Message her that afternoon.
Duc and Kalani are running the Cardiff half together on the 5th. They've been training since June. Afterwards they're doing a big brunch, said I'm welcome.
Divya's audition for the youth orchestra was cancelled, the conductor's ill. It's been moved to Tuesday at 4. She plays viola, been at it since she was seven.
Saskia Novak, aka Sas, has her theory test tomorrow morning. Don't forget to send her a quick good luck text tonight.
Coffee with Theo. He's in a jazz trio now, gigs most Thursdays at the Crown. Next one is the 24th. He wants new drumsticks for his birthday, the Vic Firth ones.
Adaeze said Cem passed his driving test first time yesterday! She's thrilled, he's already asking to borrow her car. Need to congratulate him.
Natasha's daughter is in the school play next Wednesday evening, she's playing the Tin Man. Natasha has to leave work early that day. Her husband is filming it for the grandparents.
Abebe has his PhD viva on Monday at 10. He's been a wreck about it. His partner Ioana is taking him out for dinner afterwards whatever happens. Ring him the evening after.
Bumped into Chris at the shops. His son starts his A levels this year and is applying for medicine. Chris works nights at the hospital now.
Sara ran the Great North Run on Sunday, finished in 2:04. Her sister Svetlana did it too but pulled a calf at mile 9. Check in on Svetlana later this week.
Mohammed and Noor are going to see Arctic Monkeys at the O2 on the 30th. Noor's birthday is two days before so it's sort of her present. She'd love a band tee apparently.
Rhys's band has a battle of the bands final Saturday at 8pm. He's nervous because the bassist only joined last month. Their drummer Andre is also his flatmate. I'm going with Louis.
Pick up dry cleaning Friday before 5, then the grocery shop.
Arturo's mock exams start Monday. His mum Carmen says he's barely revising, glued to his PlayStation. She asked me to have a word. I should take him for a coffee on the weekend before.
Isla got a distinction in her grade 8 singing exam! Results came Tuesday. She wants to audition for the conservatoire next spring.
Jun is doing his first stand-up open mic on the 18th at 9pm at the Comedy Cellar. Super nervous, practising on his cat Biscuit. Go along and heckle gently.
Marisol's netball team are in the county final on Saturday at 2. Her coach thinks they can win. She mentioned her knee is strapped up though. Text her that evening to see how it went.
Ciara and her husband are hosting a quiz night at the club Friday at 7. Ciara said they'd need help with scoring. I'm bringing the raffle prizes.
Elena failed her driving test this morning, third time. Really down about it. Her dad says she should take a break for a while. Must message her tomorrow.

Chat with Samir and his sister Noor. Noor sits her GCSE maths tomorrow morning and then English the day after. Samir is driving her in both days. She loves chess, plays online every evening. Wish her luck tonight.
Duc's dad had his citizenship test last week and passed. Duc is so proud. Family meal at theirs on Sunday to celebrate.
Kalani mentioned she's taken up bouldering and goes three times a week. Hates running now.

Matilda's son Louis has a swimming gala on the 9th at half 6. He got picked for the relay team, first time. Matilda's working late that day so her sister is taking him. I said I'd go cheer. Ask Louis how it went the next day.
Hamza's cricket final got rained off on Saturday. Rescheduled to the 26th, 11am start. He's captain this season.
Siobhan's grandad is in a brass band and they're playing at the Christmas fair on the 3rd. She's taking her kids. Grandad is 82 and still plays the cornet.
Theo and his girlfriend Saskia are going to Edinburgh for the Fringe in August, staying a week. He's performing one night, she's doing tech. Theo's mum is looking after their dog Rolo.

Divya told me her brother Rhys has his medical school interview Thursday at 10:30. He's nervous, their parents are pushing him hard. Divya is helping him prep the night before. Remind me to text Rhys good luck Wednesday night.
Natasha's ballet show, the Nutcracker, was meant to be the 14th but the theatre flooded so it's off. They're doing a smaller showcase in the school hall instead on the 21st at 6.
Adaeze is a pharmacist at Boots, been there 8 years. Allergic to nuts. Loves Afrobeats, wants tickets to Burna Boy.
Quick one: Abebe's daughter passed her 11 plus! Got into the grammar. Send a card.

Ioana's choir is singing at the cathedral on Sunday evening. Then a week after, they're off to Prague for a competition. She's anxious about the solo. Her husband Mohammed is flying out to watch the final. Should send her a message the day before they fly.
Chris got his Open University results, a 2:1 in history after six years part time. Graduation is next July. His wife Carmen is planning a surprise party.
Sara's son Jun has his trumpet grade 5 next Tuesday at 2:15. Sara says he's cool about it, she's the one panicking. Afterwards they're going for pizza.
Feeling slack. Book my own driving lesson for Monday at 8am and actually revise the Highway Code this time.
Svetlana mentioned she's vegan now and does pottery on Wednesdays. Her partner Andre is a firefighter.
Arturo's band is supporting a touring act at the Fleece on the 15th. Doors at 7, they're on at 8. Arturo plays lead guitar and writes most of the songs. Get tickets for me and Isla.
Talked to Cem's mum at pickup. Cem's got his cello exam on the 2nd, and his little sister Ciara is in the nativity a week after. She's very proud of both. Cem's a bit wobbly about the exam, she says.
Noor did the Tough Mudder last Saturday with her work mates. Came back covered in bruises but loved it. Ask her for photos.

Phone call with Uncle Abebe. Cousin Hamza's graduation is Wednesday at 11, Kalani's coming down for it the night before. Uncle Abebe wants us all at the restaurant afterwards at 6. He's had a bad back so won't stay late. I'm bringing the cake.
Rhys got his A level results this morning, AAB, missed his offer by one grade. He's gutted and waiting on clearing. His mum is calling the uni tomorrow. Should check on him Friday.
Andre is doing a charity boxing match on the 28th at 7pm. He's lost 10kg training for it. His girlfriend Marisol can't watch, too scared. Sponsor him before the fight.
Louis and Elena got engaged at the concert last weekend, right in the middle of the encore! Engagement party at hers on the 19th.
Gig night was great.
Jun started teaching guitar to kids on Saturdays. He's saving up for a Fender Telecaster. Lives with his gran in Didsbury.

Isla's daughter has her first ballet exam on the 7th, morning slot at 9:45. Isla's more nervous than she is. Her mother-in-law is making the costume. The day after is her daughter's 6th birthday too. Get her a present, something sparkly, she's into unicorns.
Matilda Evans from work is doing the London Marathon in April. First one. Running for the hospice that cared for her dad. Donate when the page goes up.
Carmen's nephew is in the Matilda musical at the Palace, opening night Friday at half 7. She's got spare tickets and offered me one. Go and say well done to him afterwards.
Mohammed told me he's resitting his accountancy exam on the 10th. Failed it by 2% in June. He's studying every night after the kids are in bed. Text him the morning of it.
Saskia's dad, Mr Novak, plays in a veterans' rugby side. They have a cup match on Sunday at 2. Saskia says he's 61 and refuses to retire.

Saw Svetlana and Ioana at the school gate. Svetlana's son passed his trampolining grade, Ioana's daughter got a merit in her recorder exam. Both kids are doing the talent show on the 20th, and the dress rehearsal is the day before after school. Svetlana is doing hair and makeup for everyone.
Need to buy a new phone charger and post the parcel to Gran before Thursday.

Ciara said her sister Aaliyah has the final callback for the panto on Monday at 1pm. Fingers crossed. If she gets it rehearsals start the week after. Aaliyah's been working at a cafe while auditioning. Message Aaliyah Monday evening to find out.
Theo's driving test was Tuesday morning. Haven't heard anything. Ask him how it went.
Sara and Chris went to the Wimbledon qualifiers on Thursday. Got sunburnt. Chris plays tennis every Sunday at the club and wants a new racket for Christmas.

Kalani's son Cem is sitting his black belt grading at the dojo on the 16th at 10am, then the club dinner that evening. He's been practising katas in the garden every day. His dad Duc can't make it, working abroad that week. Kalani's quite stressed juggling it all. I should offer to drive them, and call Kalani the day after to see how it went.
Divya Gupta is learning Spanish for her trip to Mexico in March. Her girlfriend Natasha is Mexican, they're visiting her family in Oaxaca.

Marisol's dad passed away in the summer and her brother Arturo is running the Berlin marathon in his memory on the 29th. She's flying out the day before to support him. Still finding things hard. Check in on her when she's back.
